description: PolyBench 2MM expression: tmp = alpha*A*B, then D = tmp*C + beta*D for square single-precision matrices. Two dependent tiled products run once. Emits raw per-stage GPU times; leading-order logical work 4*N^3 is derived downstream.

non_scaling_params.name: alpha
non_scaling_params.description: Scaling factor applied once to the first matrix product A*B.

non_scaling_params.name: beta
non_scaling_params.description: Scaling factor for the initial final-output matrix D; no initial temporary contribution.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Run the clock/cache warmer after input uploads and before the complete two-stage pass. No warmer runs between products; achieved clock/cache state requires target qualification.
